faces.name: Magnanimous Magistrate
faces.oracleText:
This creature enters with five reprieve counters on it.
Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, if its mana value was 1 or greater, you may remove that many reprieve counters from this creature. If you do, return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control.

faces.name: Magnetic Flux
faces.oracleText: Artifact creatures you control gain flying until end of turn.

faces.name: Magnetic Mine
faces.oracleText: Whenever another artifact is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, this artifact deals 2 damage to that artifact's controller.

faces.name: Magnetic Mountain
faces.oracleText:
Blue creatures don't untap during their controllers' untap steps.
At the beginning of each player's upkeep, that player may choose any number of tapped blue creatures they control and pay {4} for each creature chosen this way. If the player does, untap those creatures.

faces.name: Magnetic Snuffler
faces.oracleText:
When this creature enters, return target Equipment card from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to this creature.
Whenever you sacrifice an artifact, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

faces.name: Magnetic Theft
faces.oracleText: Attach target Equipment to target creature. (Control of the Equipment doesn't change.)

faces.name: Magnetic Web
faces.oracleText:
If a creature with a magnet counter on it attacks, all creatures with magnet counters on them attack if able.
Whenever a creature with a magnet counter on it attacks, all creatures with magnet counters on them block that creature this turn if able.
{1}, {T}: Put a magnet counter on target creature.

faces.name: Magnificent End
faces.oracleText:
This spell costs {3} less to cast if it targets a tapped creature.
Magnificent End deals 5 damage to target creature.
